oak_pallet.name: Prof. Oak
oak_pallet.dialogue_default: It's dangerous to go alone! Take these.
oak_pallet.dialogue_post_flag: How is your Pokédex coming along? Catch 'em all!

route_1_clerk.name: Shop Clerk
route_1_clerk.dialogue_default: Hi there! I'm from the Viridian City Poké Mart! I've got a free sample for trainers passing through. Here, take this!
route_1_clerk.dialogue_post_flag: Make sure to stock up on Poké Balls if you plan on catching wild Pokémon!

guard_route8.name: Thirsty Guard
guard_route8.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
guard_route8.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm so thirsty... But I can't accept just anything. Bring me a refreshing drink from the Celadon Dept. Store rooftop!
guard_route8.dialogue_post_flag: Thanks for the drink! The road to Saffron City is open.

fossil_scientist_dome.name: Lab Scientist 1
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_default: Ah, the Dome Fossil! I can resurrect this into Kabuto using our machine.
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have a Dome Fossil for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Kabuto.

fossil_scientist_helix.name: Lab Scientist 2
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_default: Ah, the Helix Fossil! I can resurrect this into Omanyte using our machine.
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have a Helix Fossil for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Omanyte.

celadon_mansion_eevee.name: Eevee Manager
celadon_mansion_eevee.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I've been looking for someone to take these rare Pokémon off my hands. I have three EEVEEs — would you like them?
celadon_mansion_eevee.dialogue_post_flag: Make sure you evolve your EEVEEs with the right stones to suit your team!

route4_magikarp_salesman.name: Magikarp Salesman
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_default: Hello there! Have I got a deal for you! I'll let you have a magnificent Magikarp for just ¥500!
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_req_unmet: You'll need ¥500 if you want to buy this incredible Pokémon!
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_post_flag: No refunds! That Magikarp is a fine specimen.

ss_anne_captain.name: Captain
ss_anne_captain.dialogue_default: Urrp! I feel seasick... Oh, you want to learn how to cut trees? Take this HM01!
ss_anne_captain.dialogue_post_flag: Urrp... Thank you for rubbing my back. You can use Cut outside of battle to clear small trees.

cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.name: Super Nerd
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_default: I'm looking for a Ponyta. Want to trade it for my Seel?
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_req_unmet: Hmm, that's not a Ponyta. Bring me one if you want to trade!
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't my old Seel doing great?

pewter_museum_clerk.name: Museum Guide
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_default: Welcome to the Pewter Museum of Science! Admission is ¥50. Would you like to enter?
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_req_unmet: Oops, looks like you're short on cash. Admission is ¥50!
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_post_flag: Enjoy looking at the fossils and space exhibit!

safari_zone_gate_attendant.name: Safari Warden
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_default: Welcome to the Safari Zone! It's ¥500 for a pass, and you get 30 Safari Balls to catch all you want.
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have enough money for the Safari Pass. Come back with ¥500!
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_post_flag: Keep an eye on your step count and your Safari Balls!

victory_road_guard.name: League Guard
victory_road_guard.dialogue_default: Only trainers who have proven themselves against all eight Gym Leaders can pass through to Victory Road.
victory_road_guard.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have all eight Gym Badges yet! You need the Earth Badge and all the others to prove your strength.
victory_road_guard.dialogue_post_flag: Ah, you possess all eight Badges! Go right ahead, and good luck at the Pokémon League!

oak_pallet_dex.name: Prof. Oak
oak_pallet_dex.dialogue_default: Ah, back again! How is your Pokédex coming along? Remember, the goal is to catch all 151 Pokémon species in Kanto! Every new species brings you closer to completing it. Keep at it!

bill_maniac.name: Bill
bill_maniac.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Yikes! You startled me! I was experimenting with my teleporter and got fused with a Pokémon! ...There we go, all fixed! Thanks! Take this S.S. Ticket — the ship leaves from Vermilion City!
bill_maniac.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] Enjoy your cruise! The S.S. Anne leaves from Vermilion City.

pewter_museum_scientist.name: Museum Scientist
pewter_museum_scientist.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Ah, Old Amber! Ancient resin with Pokémon DNA trapped inside. We don't have the equipment to revive it here — but the Pokémon Lab on Cinnabar Island does. Take it there!

fossil_scientist_amber.name: Lab Scientist 3
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_default: Ah, the Old Amber! I can resurrect this into Aerodactyl using our machine.
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have any Old Amber for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Aerodactyl.

lavender_youngster.name: Youngster
lavender_youngster.dialogue_default: This town is famous for POKéMON TOWER. The TOWER is a resting place for POKéMON.

lavender_gramps.name: Gramps
lavender_gramps.dialogue_default: In POKéMON TOWER, there are POKéMON spirits. You should respect them!

lavender_girl.name: Little Girl
lavender_girl.dialogue_default: My CUBONE's mother is in POKéMON TOWER... Poor CUBONE!

lavender_cooltrainer.name: Cooltrainer
lavender_cooltrainer.dialogue_default: I heard that someone in CELADON has something that can help in POKéMON TOWER.

lavender_center_gentleman.name: Gentleman
lavender_center_gentleman.dialogue_default: In POKéMON TOWER, the spirits of dead POKéMON rest. It's very sacred.

lavender_center_nerd.name: Super Nerd
lavender_center_nerd.dialogue_default: TEAM ROCKET is up to no good in POKéMON TOWER! Those awful people!

lavender_mart_youngster.name: Youngster
lavender_mart_youngster.dialogue_default: Do you know about the POKéMON TOWER? It's a cemetery for POKéMON!

lavender_cubone_girl.name: Brunette Girl
lavender_cubone_girl.dialogue_default: I hate those horrible ROCKETs! That poor CUBONE's mother... It was killed trying to escape from TEAM ROCKET!

lavender_fuji_girl.name: Little Girl
lavender_fuji_girl.dialogue_default: This is really MR.FUJI's house. He's really kind! He looks after abandoned and orphaned POKéMON!

snorlax_route11.name: Snorlax
snorlax_route11.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Snorlax woke with a tremendous yawn! It lumbers about, ready to battle... (Something stirs nearby.)
snorlax_route11.dialogue_req_unmet: [DRAFT] A huge Snorlax is fast asleep at the east end of Route 11, blocking the road to Route 12. It won't budge... They say a certain flute's melody can wake sleeping Pokémon.
snorlax_route11.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] Snorlax is wide awake now, and seems eager to test its strength!

lavender_fuji_nerd.name: Super Nerd
lavender_fuji_nerd.dialogue_default: That's odd, MR.FUJI isn't here. Where'd he go?

oaks_aide_flash.name: Oak's Aide
oaks_aide_flash.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] You cut through the thicket! I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. The Professor asked me to reward resourceful young trainers — please take this HM05! Its FLASH can illuminate even the darkest cave.
oaks_aide_flash.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] FLASH lights even the darkest dungeons! In battle it lowers the foe's accuracy, too.

pallet_kid.name: Kid
pallet_kid.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] When I grow up I'm going to be a Pokémon Master, just like you!

pallet_elder.name: Elder
pallet_elder.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Professor Oak was just a boy when he started studying Pokémon... Now look at him.

viridian_traveler.name: Traveler
viridian_traveler.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Viridian Forest is crawling with Bug Pokémon. Stock up on Potions before you go in!

viridian_shopper.name: Shopper
viridian_shopper.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The shop here has the best prices this side of Pewter, or so they tell me.

viridian_kid.name: Kid
viridian_kid.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] My daddy works at the Gym! He's super strong! ...He's never home, though.

pewter_museum_goer.name: Tourist
pewter_museum_goer.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The Museum's fossil exhibit is amazing! They say real Pokémon bones are inside!

pewter_rock_fan.name: Hiker
pewter_rock_fan.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Pewter sits on solid bedrock — the hardest stone in all Kanto!

pewter_kid.name: Kid
pewter_kid.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Brock's Onix is HUGE! I saw it through the Gym window once!

cerulean_swimmer.name: Swimmer
cerulean_swimmer.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The river here is perfect for Water Pokémon! Misty's Starmie loves it.

cerulean_artist.name: Artist
cerulean_artist.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I'm painting the river... but the light never sits still long enough!

cerulean_biker.name: Biker
cerulean_biker.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Someday I'll ride my bike all the way to FUCHSIA CITY!

vermilion_fisher.name: Fisher
vermilion_fisher.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I caught a MAGIKARP this big! ...Well, okay, maybe this big.

vermilion_tourist.name: Tourist
vermilion_tourist.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The S.S. Anne! I've never seen a ship so grand!

vermilion_dockworker.name: Dockworker
vermilion_dockworker.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Careful near the cranes, kid. This port never sleeps.

route1_kid.name: Kid
route1_kid.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I just started my journey too! Let's both do our best!

viridian_forest_camper.name: Camper
viridian_forest_camper.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Shh... I heard a PIKACHU rustling in the bushes over there...

route4_hiker.name: Hiker
route4_hiker.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Mt. Moon looms ahead. The tunnel through is dark and long — pace yourself.

route6_commuter.name: Commuter
route6_commuter.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I walk this road to Saffron every day for work. My feet know every stone.

route24_picnicker.name: Picnicker
route24_picnicker.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The trainers on Nugget Bridge are the toughest around! Bring your best team.

route22_jogger.name: Jogger
route22_jogger.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I run this route every morning. Great training for my Pokémon too!

tower_mourner_1.name: Mourner
tower_mourner_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] My poor RATICATE... Rest well, my friend.

tower_mourner_2.name: Mourner
tower_mourner_2.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Shh... This is a place of rest. Show some respect.

tower_mourner_3.name: Elder
tower_mourner_3.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Pokémon Tower watches over every departed soul in Kanto.

tower_purified_npc.name: Channeler
tower_purified_npc.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] This spot is purified... The air itself heals the weary. Rest a moment if you need it.

tower_ghost_hint.name: Restless Presence
tower_ghost_hint.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] A chilling presence fills the top of the tower... Your Pokémon are too scared to approach! (Something like a SILPH SCOPE might reveal it.)

mr_fuji_tower.name: Mr. Fuji
mr_fuji_tower.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Heh? You came to save me? Thank you... but I came here of my own free will, to calm the soul of CUBONE's mother. Her spirit has gone to the afterlife now. Please — take this Poké Flute. Its melody wakes even the deepest sleeper.
mr_fuji_tower.dialogue_req_unmet: [DRAFT] Heh? A visitor? ...TEAM ROCKET is still here, and CUBONE's mother still screams above. Come back when this tower is at peace.
mr_fuji_tower.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] Has my flute helped you? Play it near any sleeping Pokémon, and watch them spring awake!

thirsty_guard_route5.name: Thirsty Guard
thirsty_guard_route5.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
thirsty_guard_route5.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm sooo thirsty... If only I had something to drink... (The vending machines on the CELADON Department Store roof sell drinks.)
thirsty_guard_route5.dialogue_post_flag: Ahh, that hit the spot! SAFFRON CITY is open to you, kid!

thirsty_guard_route6.name: Thirsty Guard
thirsty_guard_route6.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
thirsty_guard_route6.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm sooo thirsty... If only I had something to drink... (The vending machines on the CELADON Department Store roof sell drinks.)
thirsty_guard_route6.dialogue_post_flag: Ahh, that hit the spot! SAFFRON CITY is open to you, kid!

thirsty_guard_route7.name: Thirsty Guard
thirsty_guard_route7.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
thirsty_guard_route7.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm sooo thirsty... If only I had something to drink... (The vending machines on the CELADON Department Store roof sell drinks.)
thirsty_guard_route7.dialogue_post_flag: Ahh, that hit the spot! SAFFRON CITY is open to you, kid!

thirsty_guard_route8.name: Thirsty Guard
thirsty_guard_route8.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
thirsty_guard_route8.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm sooo thirsty... If only I had something to drink... (The vending machines on the CELADON Department Store roof sell drinks.)
thirsty_guard_route8.dialogue_post_flag: Ahh, that hit the spot! SAFFRON CITY is open to you, kid!

celadon_clerk_tm18.name: Clerk
celadon_clerk_tm18.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Welcome to the Celadon Department Store! Here's a free sample for our valued customers — TM18, Counter!

celadon_clerk_2.name: Clerk
celadon_clerk_2.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] The vending machines are on the roof, dearie. Best Lemonade in Kanto!

celadon_tourist.name: Tourist
celadon_tourist.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Celadon is the biggest city in Kanto! The Department Store alone takes all day!

celadon_gambler.name: Gentleman
celadon_gambler.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] They say the Game Corner's prizes are extraordinary... Not that I'd know anything about that.

celadon_mansion_freak.name: Game Freak
celadon_mansion_freak.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] We're designing a new game... Someday, someone will complete the entire Pokédex!

gamecorner_coin_clerk.name: Coin Clerk
gamecorner_coin_clerk.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Welcome to the Game Corner, kid! Coins are the name of the game here. First visit? Then take this Coin Case, on the house -- it holds up to 9,999 coins. We sell 500 coins for just ¥1,000. Best rate in Kanto, no questions asked!

gamecorner_prize_clerk.name: Prize Clerk
gamecorner_prize_clerk.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Step right up! Trade your hard-won coins for fabulous prizes: rare Pokémon you can't find anywhere else, plus choice TMs!

gamecorner_slots_1.name: Slot Machine
gamecorner_slots_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] A flashy slot machine, humming with promise. Bet 1 to 3 coins per spin. Three 7s pays 300! Feeling lucky?

gamecorner_slots_2.name: Slot Machine
gamecorner_slots_2.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] A flashy slot machine, humming with promise. Bet 1 to 3 coins per spin. Three 7s pays 300! Feeling lucky?

gamecorner_gambler_1.name: Gambler
gamecorner_gambler_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Shhh! I'm on a hot streak... well, I was, until that third reel. The slots here are brutal, but the prizes! Have you SEEN that Porygon?

gamecorner_gambler_2.name: Gentleman
gamecorner_gambler_2.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I come here for the ambiance, my good fellow. The clatter of coins, the thrill of the reels... and the occasional Dratini, of course.

gamecorner_gambler_3.name: Little Girl
gamecorner_gambler_3.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] My brother found coins just lying on the floor! He says you need one of those coin case thingies first, though.

hideout_b1f_lookout.name: Rocket Grunt
hideout_b1f_lookout.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Psst... you want the boss? He's in the office, two floors down. You didn't hear it from me, got it?

hideout_b2f_mechanic.name: Rocket Grunt
hideout_b2f_mechanic.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] I installed the spinner tiles myself. Step on one and WHOOSH, you're across the room! Disorienting, ain't it? Good thing they took most of 'em out.

mr_psychic.name: Mr. Psychic
mr_psychic.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Hmm... I sense great psychic potential in you! Take this TM. It contains Psychic, the ultimate psychic technique!
mr_psychic.dialogue_repeat: [DRAFT] Psychic is the most powerful psychic move there is. Use it well!

saffron_townsperson_1.name: Townsfolk
saffron_townsperson_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Sabrina's gym is a maze of warp tiles! One wrong step and you're back at the entrance. Bring strong physical attackers -- her psychic types hate those.

saffron_townsperson_2.name: Townsfolk
saffron_townsperson_2.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Did you know Saffron has TWO gyms? The Fighting Dojo isn't official, but the Karate Master gives away rare Pokémon to anyone strong enough to beat him!

saffron_townsperson_3.name: Townsfolk
saffron_townsperson_3.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Silph Co. makes all sorts of amazing devices... like the Silph Scope! Lately there've been some shady characters hanging around their building, though.

silph_employee_1.name: Silph Employee
silph_employee_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Welcome to Silph Co.! ...Um, actually, we're not receiving visitors right now. The upper floors are... off limits. Company orders. Sorry!

silph_scientist_1.name: Scientist
silph_scientist_1.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] My research on the Silph Scope is almost complete! Being able to see ghosts... what a breakthrough! If only those Rocket thugs would leave us alone...
